legacy_conformance_harness_deferrals: Run selection does not filter by issue; this audit independently bound telemetry work_item and pipeline ID to issue 5/run 9 and checked issue-specific actors. General concurrent-run selection hardening is a separate follow-up.

Capture Kubernetes pod imageID before automatic sandbox cleanup in future runs. The current run and audit pods are deleted; per-image local IDs, immutable bases, exact policy hashes and the unchanged image-tag history are recorded, but pod imageID is not retained.
